subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as one advisory mitigation layer for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The remaining question is product and operator policy: install-time network probing, a new environment opt-out, and overlap with update CLI warnings are deliberate behavior choices rather than mechanical defects.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, while keeping the stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Packaged Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for a real package update or rollback run with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Use One Recovery Layer
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the update CLI or runtime stale-import handling to be the only warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only mitigation after maintainer review, while keeping the stale-gateway issue open for full recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily an operator-experience and package lifecycle decision, and steipete has the strongest visible adjacent package/release ownership signal in the reviewed history.
